mappings.note: Translation v1 introduces the context ('Or Moïse dit aux enfants d'Israël tout ce que l'Éternel lui avait commandé') which is not present in OSMAIN. OSMAIN starts directly with Moses speaking to the heads of the tribes.
Translation v2 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v1 (Moses speaking to the heads of the tribes).
Translation v3 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v2 (Man making a vow).
Translation v4 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v3 (Woman making a vow while young in father's house).
Translation v5 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v4 (Father hears and remains silent -> vows stand).

Translation v6 covers the first half of OSMAIN v5 (Father forbids -> vows null). However, it cuts off before the phrase 'Herren vil tilgi henne' (The Lord will forgive her), which appears at the end of OSMAIN v5 and continues into the start of OSMAIN v6 in the source text structure, though syntactically it belongs to the thought in v5. In this specific mapping, Translation v6 ends with 'car son père l'a désavouée', missing the forgiveness clause found in OSMAIN v5.
Translation v7 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v6 (If she marries while under vows).
Translation v8 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v7 (Husband hears and remains silent -> vows stand).
Translation v9 covers the first half of OSMAIN v8 (Husband forbids -> nullifies). It cuts off before 'da vil Herren tilgi henne' (then the Lord will forgive her).
Translation v10 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v9 (Widow or divorced woman's vows stand).
Translation v11 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v10 (Woman in husband's house makes a vow).
Translation v12 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v11 (Husband hears and remains silent -> vows stand).
Translation v13 covers the first half of OSMAIN v12 (Husband annuls -> null). It cuts off before 'og Herren vil' (and the Lord will).
Translation v14 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v13 (Husband can confirm or annul vows of affliction).
Translation v15 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v14 (Husband remains silent day after day -> confirms).
Translation v16 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v15 (Husband annuls later -> bears guilt).
Translation v17 corresponds exactly to OSMAIN v16 (Summary of regulations).

extraContent.description: The entire verse 'Or Moïse dit aux enfants d'Israël tout ce que l'Éternel lui avait commandé.' is extra content not found in OSMAIN. OSMAIN begins directly with Moses addressing the tribal heads.
